newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Veba unit wins Deutschbau privatisation tender.
newsitem.headline: German Veba unit wins Deutschbau privatisation tender.

text.p: Veba Immobilien AG, the property arm of German diversified utility Veba AG has won the tender to privatise the state property company, Deutschbau, the German ministry for construction and housing said on Friday.
The ministry for construction and housing, with the finance ministry, said in a statement that outstanding negotiations concerning the sale of Deutschbau shares would be handled by Veba Immobilien.
The German government currently holds 58 percent of Deutschbau, while the German post office owns 42 percent of the company, which owns 38,000 apartments in Germany.
The company will be operated as an independent company.
